name: matrix remodeling associated 5

function.text: MXRA5 is the approved symbol for matrix remodeling associated 5. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in extracellular matrix structural constituent; response to transforming growth factor beta.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

selection_reason: Added to ensure complete representation of genes in the three Cancer Hotspots original release workbooks.

editorial.change_note: Initial Cancer Hotspots dictionary supplement. Pathologist review needed — LLM-generated summary/review.

function.text: MXRA5 encodes matrix remodeling associated 5. Its functions include extracellular matrix structural constituent and response to transforming growth factor beta.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MXRA5 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.
